runners_up.title: Message Passing Systems (Part 1/2/3)
runners_up.reason_rejected: Splits shared-memory/message-passing content across 3 extra separate videos on top of the general IPC video, which combined with a producer-consumer pick and pipes pick would exceed the 3-video cap; the single 'Interprocess Communication' video already covers both models sufficiently for GATE scope.

runners_up.title: Shared Memory Systems
runners_up.reason_rejected: Redundant with 'Interprocess Communication' overview pick which already covers the shared memory model; adding it would fragment coverage unnecessarily.

runners_up.title: Introduction to FIFOs (aka named pipes) in C
runners_up.reason_rejected: Companion video to the picked pipes video covering named pipes specifically; not included to stay within the 3-video cap for English, though it is the natural next watch for named-pipe depth.

runners_up.title: Pipes Part-2 Explained in Hindi
runners_up.reason_rejected: Companion to the picked Pipes Part-1 (Hinglish), likely covering named pipes in more depth; not included to stay within the 3-video cap.

runners_up.title: L-3.1: Process Synchronization | Process Types | Race Condition
runners_up.reason_rejected: Extremely popular but is about process synchronization/race conditions broadly, not IPC models (shared memory/message passing) or pipes specifically -- belongs to the Process Synchronization topic, not T4.

runners_up.title: Inter Process Communication Explained in Hindi l ERTOS Course
runners_up.reason_rejected: Lower like ratio (2.66% but far fewer total engagement signals and part of a fragmented multi-video ERTOS series) than the Sudhakar Atchala pick; overlaps content already covered by the chosen Hinglish IPC-models video.

runners_up.title: 4.13 Producer Consumer Problem | Semaphores
runners_up.reason_rejected: Solid alternative for producer-consumer in Hindi but has far fewer views/likes than the Gate Smashers pick (438K vs 1.7M) and mixes in semaphore mechanics more than pure IPC framing.

coverage_gaps: Named pipes (FIFO) get lighter/indirect treatment: the picked pipes videos (5 Minutes Engineering Part-1 in Hinglish, CodeVault in English) primarily cover unnamed/anonymous pipes; dedicated named-pipe deep dives exist as companion videos from the same channels (5 Minutes Engineering Pipes Part-2; CodeVault's Introduction to FIFOs) but were excluded to respect the 3-video-per-language cap. No single popular GATE-focused channel (Gate Smashers, Knowledge Gate, Neso Academy) has a dedicated named-vs-unnamed-pipes lecture with strong view counts.
